item.title: eto — Monday, September 28, 2026
item.description: The Monday, September 28, 2026 edition: 3 stories, each one event told through outlets that disagree.
item.content:encoded:
Trade talk

  • Get Your Latest NBA News From RealGM's Basketball Wiretap — RealGM · Get all the latest news and happenings from around the NBA with RealGM's Basketball Wiretap.
  • Mavs Intend To Keep Dwight Powell On Roster — RealGM
  • Blake Wesley, Clippers Sign One-Year Deal — RealGM · The Los Angeles Clippers are signing Blake Wesley to a one-year deal, sources told Jake Fischer of The People's Insider. The 23-year-old guard averaged 4.8 points and 2.0 assists in 31 games for the Blazers last year.
  • Blazers Notes: Morant, Potter, Carlson, Arena — Hoops Rumors · Blazers trade for Ja Morant, add Micah Potter and Branden Carlson; Moda Center remodel costs $600MM, faces protests.
  • Jalen Duren Expected To Skip Pistons Media Day Amid Contract Stalemate — RealGM · Jalen Duren expected to skip Pistons media day as he weighs one-year $9.6 million qualifying offer or a five-year $287 million max contract. Duren has not accepted the offer, citing perceived disrespect and lack of negotiation.
  • Suns Notes: Bridges, Maluach, Ighodaro, Booker — Hoops Rumors · Bridges, Maluach, Ighodaro, Booker: Suns trade for Bridges, Maluach averages 19.5 points and 12.8 rebounds, Ighodaro excels at handoffs and cutters, Booker hits 5-of-20 in four-game series.
  • Jalen Duren Expected To Miss Pistons’ Media Day — Hoops Rumors · Jalen Duren expected to miss Pistons’ media day due to no agreement on five-year, $200MM deal; he may also miss training camp start.
  • Terrell Brown Jr, Jazz Sign Exhibit 10 Contract — RealGM
  • Pistons Waive Gary Harris — RealGM
  • Terrell Brown Jr. Signs With Jazz — Hoops Rumors · Terrell Brown Jr. signs with Jazz on Exhibit 10; will likely be waived before season and join Salt Lake City Stars. Brown averaged 11.9 points, 6.4 assists, 4.1 rebounds last season with Greensboro Swarm.

News

  • Brunson gets assist from Knicks teammates, shares laughs on 'SNL' premiere — ESPN NBA · Jalen Brunson had four of his Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of "SNL."
  • Sources: Bulls trading Dillingham to Hornets for Hield — ESPN NBA · The Bulls have traded Rob Dillingham to the Hornets for Buddy Hield and cash.
  • Sources: Warriors, Curry reach 2-year extension worth $116 million — ESPN NBA · Warriors star Stephen Curry agreed to a two-year, $116 million contract extension, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Friday, ultimately opting for a pay cut and security over a max contract.
  • Hornets star Knueppel sidelined with hamstring injury — ESPN NBA · The Charlotte Hornets will be without Kon Knueppel for at least the entire preseason due to a left hamstring injury, the team announced Friday.
  • Altman on LeBron's 76ers move: Cavs have 'too much of a good thing' to worry — ESPN NBA · Cavs president of basketball operations Koby Altman said he wasn't fazed when LeBron James chose to sign with the Sixers, saying, "We're built for a sustainable run here regardless of one outcome."
  • LeBron: Maxey friendship, desire to help Embiid drove 76ers decision — ESPN NBA · LeBron James says his long-standing friendship with All-Star Tyrese Maxey and a desire to help Joel Embiid win his first NBA title played significant roles in his decision to sign with the 76ers.
  • Kyrie ready to 'kick some butt' after lengthy ACL recovery — ESPN NBA · Kyrie Irving said he is under no physical restrictions from the torn ACL in his left knee that sidelined him 19 months ago, an injury that he called "probably the best thing that happened to me."
  • 💰 Flagg's 1-of-1 rookie debut patch card sells for record $8.04M — ESPN NBA · The card was sold in early Friday morning at 2 a.m. ET.
  • Bulls-Hornets trade: Chicago adds shooting in Buddy Hield as Charlotte takes flier on Rob Dillingham — CBS Sports NBA · Hield has been traded twice this offseason while Dillingham, the No. 8 pick in 2024, is on to his third team
  • Grades for every NBA offseason signing: Why Warriors get a B for extending Steph Curry — ESPN NBA · We're grading the biggest free agent signings and extensions, including Steph's new two-year deal.

Raptors

The post What are the three most important questions the Raptors can answer this 2026-27 preseason? first appeared on Raptors Republic.
